offering_description.value: Publishes legal newspapers, online legal news and case information for lawyers, and public notices, and develops case management software licensed to courts. Sells subscriptions and advertising to legal professionals and software licenses and services to courts.

primary_products.value: legal newspapers; online legal news and case databases; court case management software

primary_services.value: public notice publishing; software implementation and support for courts

customer_segment.value: B2B: lawyers, law firms, businesses placing legal advertising; B2G: state and county courts, government agencies

revenue_model.value: subscription: print and online subscriptions to legal newspapers and databases; advertising: legal notices and classified advertising in newspapers; licensing or royalties: court case management software licenses; service fees: software implementation, maintenance and support for courts
revenue_model.category: subscription; advertising; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: case management software sold to courts; other: publishes legal news and notices, sold to lawyers and advertisers

geography_served.value: US national: California publications plus court software customers in multiple US states

specialization.value: related lines: legal publishing and court case management software serving the legal sector

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff selling software and advertising directly to courts and firms; online: website and online subscriptions to legal news and case information

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: public notice publication rules and court data security requirements

notes: Also holds a large investment portfolio, which is excluded as it is not an operating business.
